usage: run_controls.py [-h]
                       {show,inspect,prompt,result,diagnostic-log,retry,cancel,reduce}
                       ...

Small file-backed operator controls for retained dispatch attempts.

positional arguments:
  {show,inspect,prompt,result,diagnostic-log,retry,cancel,reduce}
    show                bounded read of a lane's status and result
    inspect             report retained task and attempt state
    prompt              emit one exact retained prompt artifact
    result              emit one exact retained result artifact
    diagnostic-log      emit one exact retained diagnostic-log artifact
    retry               create a new explicit retry attempt
    cancel              request cooperative cancellation of one attempt or
                        batch
    reduce              reduce explicit successful retained results

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
